question: Solve: ((112+99)² + (112-99)²)/(112 times 112 + 99 times 99)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

 (a+b)² + (a-b)² = 2(a² + b²) 

 Rightarrow (2(a² + b²))/(a² + b²) = 2 

** therefore {Answer} = 2 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 ((112+99)² + (112-99)²)/(112 times 112 + 99 times 99) 

**Concept Used:**

 (a+b)² + (a-b)² = 2(a² + b²) 

**Calculation:**

 Rightarrow ((112+99)² + (112-99)²)/(112² + 99²) 

 Rightarrow (2(112² + 99²))/(112² + 99²) 

 Rightarrow 2 

** therefore {The correct answer is } 2 **
